flag.agent_notes: Vendor 1 (Northlight Equipment Rentals) is already at high risk due to a prior duplicate-invoice incident (INV-2026-0004 resubmitted under a new number). Invoice {inv_id} ($5,000) shows no exact match against the 5 prior invoices, but several concerns warrant verification before payment: (1) amount is ~271% above the vendor's typical invoice range ($640-$2,300), (2) invoice number 'INV-b05a61-T' breaks the vendor's established sequential numbering (INV-2026-0001..0005), and (3) the vendor has a documented resubmission history. Recommend HOLD and verify invoice {inv_id} against rental agreement #3456 and prior invoices to rule out resubmission before releasing for payment.

C1dup.summary:
Independently reviewed invoice {inv_id} (vendor 1, Northlight Equipment Rentals LLC, $5,000, camera/lighting package rental, agreement #3456).

Findings:
- No exact duplicate found: compared against all 5 prior invoices (INV-2026-0001 through 0005, $640-$2,300); no matching amount, number, or description.
- Elevated resubmission risk: vendor is already at high risk due to a prior duplicate-invoice incident (INV-2026-0004 resubmitted under a new number).
- Amount variance: $5,000 is ~271% above the vendor's typical invoice range, though the bundled multi-item rental description plausibly explains a larger amount.
- Invoice number anomaly: 'INV-b05a61-T' breaks the vendor's established sequential numbering.
- Frequency normal (6 invoices over ~5 months); industry (film production equipment rental) is not prohibited; no compliance violation evident.

Decision: Flagged invoice {inv_id} for review with reason duplicate_pattern and recommended action HOLD, pending verification against rental agreement #3456 and prior invoices to rule out resubmission. Vendor risk level maintained at high. No rejection recommended given the long-standing relationship and plausible business context. Note: admin email inbox and FinDrive were not accessible in this session, so email/document corroboration could not be performed.
